description: Fetch the transcript of a public YouTube video. Accepts a full URL or an 11-character video ID. Defaults to Markdown (title + text), which is the most compact format for reading or summarizing. Use json for timestamped segments, srt/vtt for subtitle files. Costs 1 credit on success; videos without captions (up to 2 hours long) are AI-transcribed at 1 credit per started minute (paid plans and credit packs; Free reads captions only).

end_time.description: Only return the part before this second

language.description: Preferred caption language (BCP-47, e.g. en, es, pt-BR)

mode.description: auto: captions, AI-transcribed audio if there are none. captions: never AI. ai: always transcribe the audio (1 credit per started minute). AI needs a paid plan or credit pack

original_language.description: Prefer the spoken language's captions over English

search.description: Only return lines containing this text

start_time.description: Only return the part from this second on

translate_to.description: Translate the transcript into this language

name: get_transcript
title: Get YouTube transcript
